title: Luxurious Juicy Japanese Tofu Tamagoyaki
description: A peppery and juicy Japanese dish featuring vegan white wine vinegar and sous-vide cooking, originating from Okinawa
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 160 degrees Fahrenheit
In a blender, combine crumbled tofu, vegan white wine vinegar, sesame oil, pepper, and salt, and blend until smooth
Strain the mixture through a cheesecloth into a bowl
Add kombu dashi, mirin, and Japanese soy sauce to the bowl and whisk until well combined
Pour the mixture into a tamagoyaki pan and cook in the sous-vide machine for 30 minutes
Remove the tamagoyaki from the pan and slice into rounds
Serve the Luxurious Juicy Japanese Tofu Tamagoyaki hot, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped scallions
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use
